scope: 510 selected-state train/test cached likelihood rows in ten Chapter9/10 study groups; no optimizer rerun, raw-feature reconstruction, or other-table completion.
component_convention: P event log-intensity sum; E positive integrated intensity; C=-E; M conditional mark score; joint=P+C+M. Location is distinct from timing.
reference_rule: Full-precision original components normalized to this convention; original scalars remain in the pinned source projections. No displayed-table rounding is used.
